verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email and marketing platform, since self-hostable alternatives exist in this category, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Brevo offering a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of its core product. Everything documented is a hosted SaaS service reached through APIs, SDKs and MCP; data-sync connectors and SFTP are integrations, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
